description: Executable Candidate recipe of NVIDIA's DGX Spark playbook (sglang) for gpt-oss 20b MXFP4: lmsysorg/sglang:latest-cu130 as named by the playbook (resolves to v0.5.20, build 94602c9c), pinned by arm64 digest, serving the exact model revision through sglang.launch_server with the playbook's flags, except --attention-backend triton: the playbook's flashinfer comes from its DeepSeek-V2-Lite example and SGLang rejects it for GptOssForCausalLM; plus --reasoning-parser gpt-oss and --tool-call-parser gpt-oss as in SGLang's GPT-OSS cookbook, because SGLang keeps gpt-oss's harmony special tokens in the output and only these parsers turn the channel markup into OpenAI content, reasoning and tool calls. The model's chat template is served from a vendored copy (--chat-template, sha256-checked at build) that differs from upstream only in rendering a tool's description comment when the tool has one, as openai/harmony does: the upstream template concatenates the optional function.description unconditionally and fails for a tool without one. Resource envelopes are estimates from the playbook's --mem-fraction-static, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: gpt-oss 20b MXFP4 SGLang single Spark (NVIDIA playbook)
